allow.rationale: Grants direnv permission to load .envrc/.env files, modifying the internal allow-list.

deny.rationale: Alias for block; revokes permission to load env files.

dump.rationale: The extracted text is an error message, not documentation of what 'direnv dump' does; the command also doesn't appear in the available commands list.

edit.rationale: Opens file in editor for modification and grants load permission; modifies files and direnv state.

reload.rationale: Reloads current direnv configuration; re-evaluates .envrc and changes active environment state.

status.rationale: Prints debug information about direnv state; no state modification.
